pma:database.name: two_step
pma:database.pma:table: CREATE TABLE `cart` ( `cart_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `shoe_id` bigint(11) NOT NULL, `user_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `quantity` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`cart_id`), KEY `cart_user_id_foreign` (`user_id`), CONSTRAINT `cart_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=12 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `cart_items` ( `cart_items_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `cart_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `shoe_variant_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`cart_items_id`), KEY `cart_items_cart_id_foreign` (`cart_id`), KEY `cart_items_shoe_variant_id_foreign` (`shoe_variant_id`), CONSTRAINT `cart_items_cart_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`cart_id`) REFERENCES `cart` (`cart_id`), CONSTRAINT `cart_items_shoe_variant_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`shoe_variant_id`) REFERENCES `shoe_variant` (`shoe_variant_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `customer_order` ( `customer_order_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `status_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `order_date_time` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`customer_order_id`), KEY `customer_order_status_id_foreign` (`status_id`), KEY `customer_order_user_id_foreign` (`user_id`), CONSTRAINT `customer_order_status_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`status_id`) REFERENCES `status` (`status_id`), CONSTRAINT `customer_order_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `order_details` ( `order_details_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `customer_order_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `shoe_variant_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `quantity` bigint(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`order_details_id`), KEY `order_details_customer_order_id_foreign` (`customer_order_id`), KEY `order_details_shoe_variant_id_foreign` (`shoe_variant_id`), CONSTRAINT `order_details_customer_order_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_order_id`) REFERENCES `customer_order` (`customer_order_id`), CONSTRAINT `order_details_shoe_variant_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`shoe_variant_id`) REFERENCES `shoe_variant` (`shoe_variant_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `shoe` ( `shoe_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `brand_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `category_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `shoe_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `gender_target_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `shoe_price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, PRIMARY KEY (`shoe_id`), KEY `shoe_category_id_foreign` (`category_id`), KEY `shoe_brand_id_foreign` (`brand_id`), KEY `shoe_gender_target_id_foreign` (`gender_target_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_brand_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`brand_id`) REFERENCES `brand` (`brand_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_category_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `category` (`category_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_gender_target_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`gender_target_id`) REFERENCES `gender_target` (`gender_target_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=11 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `shoe_variant` ( `shoe_variant_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `shoe_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `size_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `color_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `status_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`shoe_variant_id`), KEY `shoe_variant_shoe_id_foreign` (`shoe_id`), KEY `shoe_variant_size_id_foreign` (`size_id`), KEY `shoe_variant_color_id_foreign` (`color_id`), KEY `shoe_variant_status_id_foreign` (`status_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_variant_color_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`color_id`) REFERENCES `color` (`color_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_variant_shoe_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`shoe_id`) REFERENCES `shoe` (`shoe_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_variant_size_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`size_id`) REFERENCES `size` (`size_id`), CONSTRAINT `shoe_variant_status_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`status_id`) REFERENCES `status` (`status_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `size` ( `size_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `size_cm` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `size_us` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `size_uk` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `size_eu` bigint(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`size_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

CREATE TABLE `user` ( `user_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `fullname` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `nric` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `join_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `leave_date` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `role_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`), KEY `user_role_id_foreign` (`role_id`), CONSTRAINT `user_role_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `role` (`role_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=8 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

table.column: Sporty and suitable for either running nor jogging
